verdict.rationale: Numeral says it registers, files, and remits across jurisdictions with Autofile. Its MCP server exposes filings as tools, and the example question "are any filings waiting on my review?" implies some per-filing status is visible. The evidence never describes a filing calendar, remittance amounts, or downloadable confirmations, so only a thin slice of the story is supported. Missing for 10: calendar of upcoming returns, per-filing status detail, reporting of amounts remitted, downloadable filing confirmations, dashboard/API docs for filings, independent corroboration.
